result.summary: The tenant wrote in Polish. Water has been coming through the bathroom ceiling for about an hour, there is water near the socket by the mirror, and an elderly woman lives in the flat above. I treated this as an emergency. I sent the tenant safety advice in Polish and emailed the landlord. I couldn't send anyone out because the records have no contractor and no history for this property, so I passed the case to the operations team at high priority to send someone urgently and check on the neighbour upstairs. A hold is set to follow up in 6 hours.

Contact the upstairs flat or the building's freeholder or managing agent, and check on the elderly resident. 4. Phone the landlord and add his contact details and the property address to the CRM.

Emergency work doesn't need landlord approval, but there was no contractor on record to send, so a person has to arrange it. I gave the tenant safety steps in his own language and told the landlord at the same time.
